comparison.objective: Extract one connector terminal; record replaces a dispenser cartridge and re-engages its piston rod.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-under-tab release with coordinated wire/tool withdrawal versus dispenser manipulation, used-cartridge removal, replacement seating, ratchet orientation, and piston engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal removed without collateral release or damage versus used cartridge collected, replacement aligned, piston and pawl re-engaged, dispenser cradled, and hands released. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Both service retained components, but the record tests a multistage cartridge exchange and ratchet reassembly rather than connector depinning.
